newsitem.title: CHINA: China's State Development pumps $57 mln in Hainan.
newsitem.headline: China's State Development pumps $57 mln in Hainan.

text.p: China's State Development and Investment Co has invested 480 million yuan ($57.8 million) in port and cement projects in southern Hainan province, a company official said on Tuesday.

Of the total investment, 330 million yuan would go into the second phase construction of Yangpu harbour, with the remainder to be spent on the the island's Changjiang Cement Plant, the official said by telephone.
In the Yangpu project, three 20,000 dead-weight-tonne (DWT) berths would be built, adding a capacity of 1.2 million tonnes of freight a year, said the official, who declined to be identified.
Yangpu harbor now has two berths capable of handling ships of 20,000 DWT and another berth for vessels of 3,000 DWT.
The State Development and Investment Co would own 60 percent of the Changjiang Cement Plant after it pumped in 150 million yuan, the official said.
The money would be used to set up cement equipment with a production capacity of 820,000 tonnes of cement a year, he said but gave no further details.
